$$

$$
\text{Time} = \frac{\text{Distance}}{\text{Relative Speed}} = \frac{6.5}{3} = \frac{13}{6} \text{ hours}

\cos(2\theta) = 1 - 2 \left( \frac{x + 4}{5} \right)^2
